meta.title: Recreate with Evaluation Duration 15 Mins
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary for this case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the stage action that launches the Recreate Order popup.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order popup, keep the bidding end duration at 30 Mins, select 15 Mins for Evaluation Duration, click Create Order, and stop on the resulting event screen showing a 15-minute evaluation window after the 30-minute bidding period.

steps.note: Perform and verify the popup configuration and recreated event outcome, which have no dedicated catalog action.
Confirm the recreated event flow completed without an application error.
